htmx posts only carry the CSRF token if it is in the submitted form data or sent as a header, so a token that lives only in the base template doesn't reach a form you moved into a partial. The simplest fix is `{% csrf_token %}` inside the `<form>` in the partial. Alternatively, set `hx-headers='{"X-CSRFToken": "{{ csrf_token }}"}'` on `<body>` in the base template so every htmx request sends it. Action: add the tag inside the partial's form and check the view renders the partial with `request` so the token is available.

`as const` changes the inferred type, keeping literals and making everything readonly, but checks nothing. `satisfies` checks the value against a type without changing its inferred type, so typos and missing keys error while you keep the precise type.
